items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: You see, I worked with George back at Benefit and St. Rock, and I had my band on the side, you see.

ctx.x: Didn't you, at one time, play with George Lewis?
Well, yeah, I worked with George, I worked with George before, before Herbert Moran, and before Cuckoo.
